title: Future-bubble coffeemaker is mostly a winner!
text: Future-bubble coffeemaker is mostly a winner!. Hubs insisted on this coffee pot over the more traditional shaped percolators available. Why, you ask? Well, it just looks cool on the countertop. That said, the program function works great and he wakes up to fresh, hot coffee every day. I think the only downside to this product, if you can consider it a downside, is that since the carafe is so...well....ROUND, you have to tip it almost completely upside-down to pour out the last of the coffee. It doesn't spill or anything, it's just a little...awkward. Hence the removal of the 5th star on the review. If you can deal with the slightly awkward pouring of the carafe, then you have yourself a sleek and winning coffeepot that does what it promises - brews a heavenly cup of joe. Enjoy! (Side note - a friend came over this morning, took one look at the coffeepot, and said "what is THAT?!" in wide-eyed wonder). Haha!

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach 44755 Illusion 12 Cup Coffeemaker
description: From Hamilton Beach the Illusion Coffeemaker has a unique designer style and is programmable for wake-up morning coffee. It features auto pause and serve, drip-free pouring, two hour auto shutoff, a large clock and nonstick warmer plate. Uses basket style coffee filters.
